Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning assignment of a debt to a collection agency.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to collection agencies; and adding a new section tochapter 19.16 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No person, other than an entity subject to RCW 19.16.500, mayassign a debt to a collection agency unless: (1) The person has made an attempt to advise the debtor (a) of theexistence of the debt; and (b) that the debt may be assigned to acollection agency for collection if the debt is not paid within tendays after the date of notice of the existence of the debt; and (2) At least thirty days have elapsed from the time notice wasattempted.
